Mas, em alguns momentos, foi difícil compreender as instruções dela por conta da dificuldade no ingles. Também não houve nenhuma complementação sobre a história e a cultura das lanternas e, confesso, isso eu senti falta pois gosto de aprender sobre a história das culturas. Nem foi oferecida nenhuma sobremesa ou chá ao final...sequer um copo d'água em momento algum. E estava bastante calor. Também achei que a lanterna fosse menor... para quem tem pouco espaço na bagagem, mesmo sendo leve, é algo a considerar. Eu gostei bastante da experiência. E foi válida. reviewText: Amazing food tour with Billy! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We had such a wonderful evening exploring Hoi An’s local food scene with Billy. We tried so many delicious local dishes and learned about the stories and traditions behind them. Billy also took us to places we would never have found on our own. reviewText: We had a fantastic tour with Flower! She was knowledgeable, funny, and made the whole experience both enjoyable and informative. Every stop felt well thought out, and the food she selected for us was absolutely delicious. Our favourites were the Bánh Xèo, Anthony’s Bánh Mì, and the Kem Bơ (avocado coconut ice cream), although honestly, everything we tried was excellent. We’d definitely book with them again and highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for a fun and authentic food experience!
activityTitle: hoi an street food tour with billy

reviewText: This tour exceeded our expectations. Emily was warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about sharing local culture. The food at every stop was amazing, but what made it special was how she explained the ingredients, origins, and stories behind each dish and local family-run place. We discovered traditional Hoi An dishes we would never have found ourselves and learned so much about local life. I highly recommend doing this tour early in your trip, it gave us great ideas for where to eat and explore afterwards. One of the best tours we’ve ever done. Thank you, Emily, and hopefully we meet again someday!
activityTitle: hoi an street food tour with billy

reviewText: Billy did a fantastic job organizing everything. Before the tour, he took the time to ask what kinds of food and experiences I wanted to try and thoughtfully incorporated them into the itinerary. Communication was clear, and the meeting instructions were easy to follow. Our guide, Hoa, was absolutely amazing, engaging, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about sharing local food and culture. We tried a great variety of dishes, and at every stop she checked whether we wanted more of anything or if we’d like to try something different. What really stood out was that she even followed up the next day with recommendations for local breakfast and lunch dishes we didn’t get to try during the evening tour. Overall, this was a fantastic experience and exceptional value for money. Highly recommended!
activityTitle: hoi an street food tour with billy

reviewText: Our food tour in Hoi An was easily one of the highlights of our trip, and a huge part of that was thanks to our wonderful guide, Emily (real name Trang). She took us to incredible local hidden gems that we never would have found on our own, each one feeling authentic and special. What really stood out was how she shared the family history behind each place we visited. It added such a personal and meaningful touch to the experience—it wasn’t just about the food, but the stories and traditions behind it. She encouraged us to try dishes we would never have thought to order ourselves, and every single one was absolutely delicious. It’s genuinely hard to pick a favourite because everything was so good. If you’re looking for a food tour that goes beyond the typical tourist spots and gives you a deeper connection to the local culture, this is the one to book.

reviewText: I really enjoyed this tour. Nina was a wonderful guide, friendly, helpful, and attentive throughout the day. The cable car rides were also a highlight, offering stunning views of the mountains and surrounding landscape. I also opted for the buffet lunch, which was a nice addition to the experience. One tip: Wear comfortable walking shoes! Expect to walk around 10,000 to 12,000 steps, as there's a lot to see and explore.
